stt: Ask HN: What to read after “Thinking in Systems”?
Ask HN: What’s the hardest part about learning and using mental models?
x:
Learning them is bloody hard, personally - there are a ton of established ones to keep track of and I at times find myself trying hard to remember them vs. just moving forward and building my own.

That said this book has helped enormously -- 
https://www.amazon.com/Model-Thinker-What-Need-Know/dp/04650...

Introduced via the interview between the author and Shane Parish @ Knowledge Project (Farnam Street).

stt: Ask HN: Recommend me a course on Coursera
x:
I enjoyed taking Model Thinking: https://www.coursera.org/learn/model-thinking

It's designed to be a foundation course for subsequent social science classes, but I personally found the exposure to models from different fields of study to be quite insightful.

If you're interested, there's also a book by the professor on the same topic: https://www.goodreads.com/en/book/show/39088592-the-model-th...
